 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Claressa Shields has made a serious allegation against Gervonta 'Tank' Davis, claiming she personally witnessed the boxing star assault a woman at a basketball game several years ago.
 The undisputed women's heavyweight champion made the accusation during a heated social media rant that circulated on Sunday, November 8. In a video shared by Happy Punch , Shields accused Davis of repeatedly mocking her appearance over her belief that Shakur Stevenson would defeat him in a potential fight.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Photo by Joe Boatman/NBAE via Getty ImagesPhoto by Joe Boatman/NBAE via Getty Images)
 Claressa Shields Claims She Witnessed Gervonta Davis Assault a Woman
 Shields claimed she had remained silent about the alleged incident for years before deciding to speak publicly.
 "Tank beat a b*tch up in my face at the basketball game. I sat on that s**t for years. I never said nothing about it," Shields said.
 She continued, "Grabbed a girl, pulled her to the back and whooped her a** in the back. I don't even know what girl it was. So I seen it with my own two eyes that he hit women."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Shields also called Davis a "woman beater" and criticized fans who continue to support him.
 Her account has not been independently verified in full, including her claim that she personally witnessed the alleged assault.
 Adam Hunger-GettyImagesAdam Hunger-GettyImages
 What Happened During Gervonta Davis' 2020 Basketball Game Incident?
 In February 2020, Davis was involved in an incident with his former girlfriend during a celebrity charity basketball game in Miami.
 Video footage circulated online showing Davis grabbing the woman and forcibly removing her from her seat. He was subsequently charged with misdemeanor battery.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement According to reporting at the time, police also reviewed surveillance footage that appeared to show Davis striking the woman in a separate room.
 Davis later acknowledged grabbing the woman's clothing but denied grabbing her by the neck.
 While the incident was documented in police reports and video footage, those records do not independently establish that Shields witnessed the encounter or confirm every detail of her latest account.
 Why Are Claressa Shields and Gervonta Davis Feuding?
 According to Shields, tensions between the two fighters stem from her prediction that Stevenson would defeat Davis.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Only reason Tank has any issue with me is my opinion. Shakur beats everybody," Shields said.
 She also accused Davis of trying to attract attention whenever she receives publicity and suggested he should focus on returning to the ring.
 "Come out of retirement and fight somebody," Shields said.
 Shields even brought Stevenson into the dispute, claiming she could call him to confront Davis.
 "I got Shakur Stevenson on speed dial. I will call Shakur to come handle you," she said.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The latest exchange has taken their public feud beyond boxing predictions and social media insults, with Shields now making a serious allegation about an incident dating back more than six years.
